extracted.name: Green goddess dressing
extracted.description: Make this creamy green goddess dressing in just 10 mins. Packed with herbs, it's perfect for drizzling over salads or roasted veg, or serving as a dip
ingredient_lines: 1 large avocado peeled, halved, stoned and roughly chopped
instruction_lines: For the dressing, tip the avocado, yogurt, chives, dill, parsley, spring onions, rice vinegar, olive oil, garlic and 1 tbsp of the lemon juice into a blender or food processor. Blitz until finely chopped and emulsified.
Season to taste, adding more lemon juice if you like. Add cold water 1 tbsp at a time until the dressing has a drizzling consistency.
